question: Major Dhyan Chand was famous for which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Field hockey.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Major Dhyan Chand was a famous Indian field hockey player who played for India from 1926 to 1948.
 
• He is regarded as one of the greatest hockey players of all time and has won three Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
